algorithm: {The proposed algorithm is a sequential variant of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) with a simple yet efficient initialization strategy and an adaptive step-size control mechanism, designed to handle highly multimodal landscapes like the Rastrigin function efficiently.}

{ **The "Genetic CMA-ES" algorithm combines a Genetic Algorithm with Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to efficiently navigate the highly multimodal Rastrigin function landscape.** }
